message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" They want earliest reference from historical record. We can answer: earliest references are in the New Testament (Gospels), but earliest external references are in Josephus (Antiquities 18.3) and Tacitus (Annals 15.44). Also maybe in the Roman sources like Pliny the Younger. But earliest external mention is Josephus, around 93-94 AD. Also maybe the earliest mention is in the Gospel of Mark, but that's internal. The question: "from historical record" implies external. So answer: Josephus, 93-94 AD. Also mention Tacitus, 116 AD. Also mention Pliny the Younger, 112 AD. Also mention the inscription on the "Pilate Stone" maybe. But earliest is Josephus. Provide details. Also mention that the earliest mention is in the "Testimonium Flavianum" in Antiquities of the Jews. Provide context. Also mention that the earliest mention is in the "Annals" by Tacitus. Provide citations. Also mention that the earliest mention is in the "Epistle of Barnabas" maybe. But the earliest external mention is Josephus. Provide answer.
